original_client_text.markup_text:
This is why you should always lightly mist your carpets before vacuuming 🚗💨 (READ DESCRIPTION)

If you’re detailing your car and skipping this step… you’re leaving dirt behind.

Lightly mist your car carpets and floor mats with APC or water before vacuuming. Here’s why👇

When the fibers are slightly damp, dust, sand, and pet hair loosen up and clump together instead of staying stuck deep in the carpet. That means your vacuum can pull out more embedded debris instead of just grabbing surface dirt.

It also helps reduce dust flying around inside the car while you clean - especially important in tight interiors.

Don’t soak the carpet. Use a fine mist only. Over-wetting can lead to odors or mildew if not dried properly.

Top tip: Use a drill brush or stiff detailing brush after misting to agitate the fibers, then vacuum for a deeper clean 🧼

Save this for your next detail.

#cardetailing #autodetailing #carcleaning #detailing #interiordetailing
